verdict_reason: Predictor receives windows with only feature columns (no sym, date, or time), windows are globally shuffled (C2), no per-call grouping by t_local can be reconstructed, and no cross-call state is allowed. The cross-sectional grouping the trick requires at inference time is structurally unavailable.
constraints_in_conflict: C1: date is zeroed at inference — cannot anchor pool by (date, t)
C2: test windows shuffled and no cross-call state allowed — cannot guarantee 5 syms at same t end up in same predict() call, cannot maintain a rolling cross-sym snapshot
C3: sym not in feature columns and forbidden from the model — cannot identify which sym a given window is

workarounds_considered.name: within-batch pooling using time as group key
workarounds_considered.rejected_because: group size unknown and unstable (often 1 with batch:1 example); severe train/inference distribution shift; time != t_local; would need time added to feature list and platform makes no batching guarantees

workarounds_considered.name: static lookup of training-time per-time-of-day stats
workarounds_considered.rejected_because: degenerates to a time-of-day feature; does not provide current-moment market state; expected gain ~ 0

workarounds_considered.name: target residualization at training only (no inference-time pooling)
workarounds_considered.rejected_because: different trick, not R33 #2; residualization at inference requires knowing the market component, which we again cannot compute

transferability_notes: Volkova JS2024 and hyd Optiver2023 both rely on Kaggle APIs that supply cross-sectional grouping directly per timestep. Our platform instead globally shuffles windows and strips identifying tags, so the structural symmetry the references rely on does not exist.
recommendation: Drop R33 #2 from candidate list under current platform contract.
Re-prioritize budget toward R33 #3 (KNN-target, inference-compatible), #5 (Triplet imbalance, within-window), #6 (Hull MA, within-window).
If a 'market state' signal is desired, derive it from within-window LOB statistics (book-imbalance Z-scores, recent volatility) instead.
